blocks.tamil_translation: there is nothing better through which you can attain nearness to Allah,” Hazrat Abu Dharr Ghifari (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَابِرٍ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: اَلْقُرْآنُ مُشَفَّعٌ وَمَاحِلٌ مُصَدَّقٌ مَنْ جَعَلَهُ أَمَامَهُ قَادَهُ إِلَي الْجَنَّةِ وَمَنْ جَعَلَهُ خَلْفَ ظَهْرِهِ سَاقَهُ إِلَي النَّارِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Jabir (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The intercession of the Holy Qur'an will be accepted. And if the Qur'an argues on someone's behalf, its argument will be accepted. Whoever keeps it in front of him (whoever acts upon it), it will take him into Jannah; whoever throws it behind his back (whoever does not act upon it), it will push him into Jahannam”.

blocks.text: Explanation:- The meaning of the Qur'an's argument being accepted is that the Qur'an will argue in the court of Allah that the ranks of those who recited the Qur'an and acted upon it should be raised; and it will ask the one who did not fulfil its duties, “Why did you not fulfil my duties?”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ﵄ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: اَلصِّيَامُ وَالْقُرْآنُ يَشْفَعَانِ لِلْعَبْدِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَقُولُ الصِّيَامُ: أَيْ رَبِّ مَنَعْتُهُ الطَّعَامَ وَالشَّهْوَةَ فَشَفِّعْنِي فِيهِ وَيَقُولُ الْقُرْآنُ: مَنَعْتُهُ النَّوْمَ بِاللَّيْلِ فَشَفِّعْنِي فِيهِ قَالَ: فَيُشَفَّعَانِ لَهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه احمد والطبراني في الكبير ورجال الطبراني رجال الصحيح مجمع الزوائد:٣ /٤١٩
